# NEW 2026-11-23 v18.0 Module 18.0-D: 3 Civilization Regency Types: Empress Curtain, Byzantine Co-Emperor & Privy Council (oe_dyn2_) (oe_dyn2_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v180_dynasty_culture.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Chartered civilization regencies (0 key collisions with vanilla or 05_/06_ oe_reg* files).

# 1. Empress Dowager Behind-the-Curtain Regency
oe_dyn2_reg_empress_curtain = {
	allow = {
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		has_variable = oe_dyn2_curtain_protocol
		has_consort = yes
		consort ?= {
			is_adult = yes
			modifier:blocked_from_cabinet = no
		}
		NOT = { ruler ?= { is_expedition_leader = yes } }
		NOT = { is_at_war_with = consort.employer }
	}

	modifier = {
		monthly_legitimacy = 0.10
		country_cabinet_efficiency = 0.08
		stability_investment = small_stability_investment
		subject_loyalty = 5
	}

	start_effect = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_active_regency value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = root.consort }
			set_regent = root.consort
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_character = { can_become_a_regent = yes }
			}
			ordered_character = {
				limit = { can_become_a_regent = yes }
				order_by = total_abilities
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = new_leader
			}
			set_regent = scope:new_leader
		}
		else = {
			hidden_effect = {
				create_character = {
					culture = root.culture
					religion = root.religion
					estate = estate_type:crown_estate
					age = 38
					female = yes
					adm = 62
					dip = 60
					mil = 42
					save_scope_as = new_leader
				}
				set_regent = scope:new_leader
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_cd_ev5 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_cd_ev5 years = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_dyn2.5 days = 1 }
		}
	}

	end_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_active_regency }
			remove_variable = oe_dyn2_active_regency
		}
		add_legitimacy = 8
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dyn2_mod_curtain_regency_legacy years = 5 mode = replace }
	}
}

# 2. Byzantine Senior Co-Emperor Regency
oe_dyn2_reg_byz_co_emperor = {
	allow = {
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		has_variable = oe_dyn2_co_emperor_charter
		OR = {
			has_or_had_tag = BYZ
			has_or_had_tag = ROM
			culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
		}
		NOT = { ruler ?= { is_expedition_leader = yes } }
	}

	modifier = {
		monthly_legitimacy = 0.12
		discipline = 0.02
		diplomatic_reputation = 1.0
		global_defensive = 0.08
	}

	start_effect = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_active_regency value = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_cabinet_character = { can_become_a_regent = yes }
			}
			ordered_cabinet_character = {
				limit = { can_become_a_regent = yes }
				order_by = total_abilities
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = new_leader
			}
			set_regent = scope:new_leader
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_character = { can_become_a_regent = yes }
			}
			ordered_character = {
				limit = { can_become_a_regent = yes }
				order_by = total_abilities
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = new_leader
			}
			set_regent = scope:new_leader
		}
		else = {
			hidden_effect = {
				create_character = {
					culture = root.culture
					religion = root.religion
					estate = estate_type:crown_estate
					age = 46
					female = no
					adm = 60
					dip = 62
					mil = 60
					save_scope_as = new_leader
				}
				set_regent = scope:new_leader
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_cd_ev6 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_cd_ev6 years = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_dyn2.6 days = 1 }
		}
	}

	end_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_active_regency }
			remove_variable = oe_dyn2_active_regency
		}
		add_prestige = 8
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dyn2_mod_co_emperor_legacy years = 5 mode = replace }
	}
}

# 3. Imperial Privy Council Regency
oe_dyn2_reg_imperial_privy_council = {
	allow = {
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		has_variable = oe_dyn2_privy_regency_charter
		country_rank = country_rank:rank_empire
		NOT = { ruler ?= { is_expedition_leader = yes } }
	}

	modifier = {
		country_cabinet_efficiency = 0.10
		tax_income_efficiency = 0.06
		global_monthly_control = 0.002
		stability_investment = small_stability_investment
	}

	start_effect = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_active_regency value = 3 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_cabinet_character = { can_become_a_regent = yes }
			}
			ordered_cabinet_character = {
				limit = { can_become_a_regent = yes }
				order_by = adm
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = new_leader
			}
			set_regent = scope:new_leader
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_character = { can_become_a_regent = yes }
			}
			ordered_character = {
				limit = { can_become_a_regent = yes }
				order_by = adm
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = new_leader
			}
			set_regent = scope:new_leader
		}
		else = {
			hidden_effect = {
				create_character = {
					culture = root.culture
					religion = root.religion
					estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
					age = 50
					female = no
					adm = 68
					dip = 58
					mil = 46
					save_scope_as = new_leader
				}
				set_regent = scope:new_leader
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_cd_ev7 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_cd_ev7 years = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_dyn2.7 days = 1 }
		}
	}

	end_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_active_regency }
			remove_variable = oe_dyn2_active_regency
		}
		add_stability = 6
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dyn2_mod_privy_regency_legacy years = 5 mode = replace }
	}
}
